skill.summary: Etsy Ads strategy — budget allocation, bid management, promoted listings, offsite ads opt-out analysis

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the etsy-advertising skill (version 1.0.0).
- Provides expert guidance on Etsy Ads strategies, including budget allocation, bid management, promoted listings, and offsite ads analysis.
- Offers shop setup audits, actionable recommendations, and step-by-step implementation plans.
- Includes comparison of advertising tools and strategies with pros/cons analysis.
- Outputs structured assessments, priority action items, tool recommendations, timelines, and KPIs.
- Focused on strategic advice; does not integrate directly with Etsy APIs.
